items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Benton? [INTERVIEWEE] Was it Tom Benton? Oh, Benton.

ctx.x: What's Tommy's name? Thomas- Jefferson? No. Thomas. Yeah, Thomas, in New Orleans. Thomas- Oakland- Oakland- Uptown he played piano and guitar. Tom.
Was it Tom Benton? Oh, Benton.
